## Source correction

Three-file delta: resolver, DEPENDENCY_MAP, new91-line real-Git integration test. Public resolver API and web/CLI caller contracts unchanged; no new domain or C4-level component introduced.

1. `git-worktree.resolver.ts:170–203` now includes each linked worktree's checkout `.git` target existence in the metadata stamp. External checkout move/deletion/restoration therefore changes the cache key even when Git's own metadata is untouched. Reads absolute/relative target paths through resolve(gitDir,target). Locked-file size/mtime is also included. No TTL or idle Git polling added.
2. `:135–148,236–254` separates a successful listing from a fulfilled failure/unsupported result. A failed result returns[] to the current caller but evicts the matching entry; a later caller retries. Identity guard prevents an older failed run evicting a newer entry. Rejected listings retain the existing eviction behavior.
3. `:151–160` memoizes the shared version check only once it succeeds; false clears the same in-flight promise so Git returning after an availability failure is retried.
4. getGitVersion catches process/version failures and returns null, so ordinary failure becomes false rather than a rejected version promise. No source-supported new rejection-cache defect found.
5. Existing single-flight, before-run stamp timing and uncached CLI behavior remain. Documentation now describes checkout existence, locked state and success-only caching.
